data.one_liner: Verifies active internet connectivity and detects slow connections by checking accessible URIs.
data.what_it_does: Checks for actual internet access by pinging or requesting accessible URIs, overcoming limitations of basic connection state plugins. Provides streams for tracking connectivity changes and supports slow connection detection.
use_when: You need to verify if the device has actual internet access rather than just a local network link.
Your app needs to react dynamically to internet connection availability changes.
You want to detect slow internet connections to manage user experience.
avoid_when: You only need to know basic local network availability without verifying server reachability.
You fail to dispose of instances or listeners, risking memory leaks.
strengths: Reliable actual internet check rather than just checking network hardware status.
Supports status change streams for reactive applications.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, macOS, Web, Linux, and Windows.
weaknesses: Requires manual disposal of instances and stream subscriptions to prevent memory leaks.
Network requests to external URIs can consume battery or data if checked too frequently.
data.setup_notes: On Android, add INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permissions to AndroidManifest.xml. On macOS, add network entitlements.

alternatives.name: connectivity_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use if you only need the device's basic network state (Wi-Fi/Cellular) and don't require actual server reachability checks.
